s.n: Beach picnic roast beef finger sandwiches
s.note: Rare roast beef and rocket on white bread with horseradish butter, cut into fingers
s.how: Beat 40g soft butter with 2 tbsp horseradish cream. Spread over 8 slices white bread, layer 4 slices with 300g rare roast beef, 50g rocket and pepper and close. Trim the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers.

s.note: Crisp pastry triangles of potato and peas with cumin, garam masala and green chilli, with mint yoghurt
s.how: Rub 3 tbsp oil into 200g plain flour and a pinch of salt, add 80ml water, knead and rest 30 minutes. Boil 500g diced potatoes until tender. Fry 1 tsp cumin seeds and 1 diced onion in 2 tbsp oil, add 1 chopped green chilli, 1 tsp garam masala, half a tsp turmeric, the potato and 100g peas, then lemon and coriander, and cool. Roll the dough into 6 rounds, halve, shape into cones, fill and seal. Fry at 170C for 5 minutes until golden. Serve with 200g Greek yoghurt mixed with chopped mint.

m.note: Citrus and garlic marinated skirt steak, charred and sliced, with charred tomato salsa, avocado and warm corn tortillas
m.how: Blend the juice of 1 orange and 2 limes, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chilli powder, 3 tbsp oil and a handful of coriander and marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours. Char 4 tomatoes, half a white onion and 1 jalapeño in a dry pan and blitz with coriander, lime and salt. Grill the steak over high heat for 4 minutes a side, rest 10 minutes and slice across the grain. Serve with 12 warm corn tortillas, sliced avocado and the salsa.

w.note: Chocolate biscuit base under a dense baked dark chocolate filling, with softly whipped cream
w.how: Crush 250g chocolate biscuits, mix with 100g melted butter and press into a 23cm tin, then chill 20 minutes. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter, whisk 3 eggs with 150g brown sugar, then mix in the chocolate, 2 tbsp cocoa and 150ml cream. Pour into the base and bake at 160C for 35 minutes. Cool, chill 2 hours and serve with 200ml whipped cream.

d.note: Tequila and blue orange liqueur shaken with fresh lime and sugar syrup, in a salt-rimmed glass
d.how: Dissolve 40g caster sugar in 40ml hot water and cool. Rub the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip in salt flakes. Shake 180ml tequila, 60ml blue curaçao, 120ml lime juice and the syrup hard with ice and strain into the glasses over fresh ice.
